claims.text: Large language models face safety concerns, such as hallucinations, that undermine their trustworthiness and effectiveness.
Large language models face security concerns, such as backdoor attacks, that undermine their trustworthiness and effectiveness.
Large language models face privacy concerns, such as privacy leakage, that undermine their trustworthiness and effectiveness.
Safety, security, and privacy in large language models constitute distinct research domains with individual definitions.

Previous works often conflated safety issues with security concerns. In contrast, our study provides clearer and more reasonable definitions for safety, security, and privacy within the context of LLMs.

methodologies.name: Comprehensive Survey and Taxonomic Categorization
methodologies.description: A systematic literature review and taxonomy organizing vulnerabilities, defenses, and research challenges across safety, security, and privacy in LLMs.

limitations.text: Previous literature often conflated safety issues with security concerns in the context of large language models.

future_work.text: Investigate unique research challenges to enhance the robustness and reliability of LLMs against emerging threats in safety, security, and privacy.
